AI 芯片为什么大部分时间都在等
en: why does an AI chip wait

title.en: Memory Latency Hierarchy and Cache Locality

description.zh: 从 L1 到 DRAM 慢了约 80 倍；因为硬件按缓存行搬运，按行遍历与按列遍历矩阵的流量可差 8 倍。
description.en: DRAM is roughly 80x slower than L1 cache; because hardware fetches full cache lines, row-major vs column-major matrix walks can differ by 8x in traffic.

zh: 按行遍历 按列遍历
为什么二维数组按行更快

title.zh: 矩阵分块与时间局部性

description.zh: 同样做 2N³ 次乘加的矩阵乘法，把小块锁进缓存能减少近十倍慢内存搬运，分块过大溢出缓存又会恶化。
description.en: Matrix multiplication does the same 2N^3 ops, yet cache-sized tiling cuts slow memory traffic nearly 10x while oversized tiles thrash capacity.

zh: 为什么同样 O(N^3) 速度差十倍

title.en: The Memory Wall and Little's Law

description.zh: 哪怕只有 2% 的缓存缺失也会拉低一半以上有效算力；要吃满高速总线，在途并发数据必须等于带宽乘延迟。
description.en: Even a 2% miss rate cuts effective compute more than half; saturating a fast memory bus requires concurrency equal to bandwidth times latency.

title.zh: 多核扩展、阿姆达尔与总线瓶颈
title.en: Multicore Scaling, Amdahl, and Bus Contention

description.zh: 登纳德缩放结束后靠多核扩展，但串行比例（阿姆达尔定律）和共享内存总线很快把加速比封顶。
description.en: After Dennard scaling ended, more cores hit serial bottlenecks (Amdahl's law) and shared memory bus saturation.

zh: 为什么多核不能线性加速

description.zh: GPU/TPU 用大量并发线程掩盖延迟，并通过脉动阵列让权重驻留片上反复复用。
description.en: GPUs and TPUs trade per-thread latency for massive warp concurrency and systolic arrays that reuse weights on-chip.

zh: 为什么 AI 用 GPU 不用 CPU

title.zh: 屋顶线模型与算术强度
title.en: The Roofline Model and Arithmetic Intensity

description.zh: 可达性能等于峰值算力与（带宽 × 算术强度）中的较小者；算术强度越过屋脊拐点才算吃满算力。
description.en: Attainable performance is min(peak FLOP/s, bandwidth x arithmetic intensity); only past the ridge point is a workload compute-bound.

zh: 内存受限 算力受限

title.zh: 大模型推理的内存瓶颈

description.zh: 自回归解码每吐一个字就要读取全部权重与 KV 缓存，单批算术强度约 1 FLOP/B；量化与批处理用于提高重用。
description.en: Autoregressive LLM decode reads all weights and KV cache per token (~1 FLOP/B at batch 1); quantization and batching shift the bottleneck.

zh: 为什么推理吃显存带宽

title.zh: 数据搬运能耗与 HBM 封装
title.en: Data Movement Energy and HBM Packaging

description.zh: 从片外 DRAM 读取数据的能耗是浮点加法的几百倍；HBM 靠极短极宽的硅中介层连线降低距离与能耗。
description.en: Fetching a word from off-chip DRAM costs hundreds of times more energy than adding it; HBM stacks dies on a wide interposer to shorten wires.

description.en: Late-2026 hardware pushes toward 2048-bit HBM4 and co-packaged optics while PIM and neuromorphic chips face area and software hurdles.

title.zh: 诊断芯片与程序的四个问题
title.en: Four Questions for Any Chip or Slow Program

description.en: Locate performance bottlenecks using four checks: stride locality, arithmetic intensity, in-flight concurrency, and off-chip boundaries.

zh: 怎么看 AI 芯片参数

label.zh: 把取指执行拆成五级流水线

reason.zh: 第 1 章承接《一堆开关是怎么学会算数的》第 9 章：把取指与执行重叠成五级流水线后，一次主存缺失就会把后续指令堵在冒泡停顿里。
reason.en: Chapter 1 builds on switches-that-compute #ch9: overlapping fetch and execute into a 5-stage pipeline retires one instruction per cycle until a memory-latency hazard fills the pipe with bubbles.

label.zh: 为什么缺失延迟会跳到几百周期
label.en: Why a miss penalty jumps from 1 to 200 cycles

reason.zh: 第 2 章解释第 1 章的物理原因：从片上 L1（1 ns）到片外 DRAM（80 ns）慢约 80 倍，而且硬件按整条缓存行搬运。
reason.en: Chapter 2 explains chapter 1's stall penalty: off-chip DRAM (~80 ns) is ~80x slower than on-chip L1 (~1 ns), and hardware fetches entire cache lines.

label.zh: 把工作集锁进缓存反复重用
label.en: Fit sub-blocks inside cache for reuse

reason.zh: 第 3 章利用第 2 章的缓存行与容量边界做矩阵分块（B=8，1,536 B ≤ 2 KB），将慢内存流量削减 7.6 倍。
reason.en: Chapter 3 applies chapter 2's cache-line and capacity limits to tiled matmul (B=8, 1,536 B <= 2 KB), cutting slow memory traffic 7.6x.

label.zh: 小缺失率乘以高延迟压垮有效算力
label.en: Tiny miss rates times long latency crush CPI

reason.zh: 第 4 章用 AMAT 把第 2 章的高缺失惩罚量化为内存墙，并用利特尔法则给出打满带宽所需的在途并发请求数。
reason.en: Chapter 4 quantifies chapter 2's miss penalty via AMAT and derives the in-flight concurrency needed to saturate bandwidth via Little's Law.

label.zh: 在途数据量 = 带宽 × 延迟

reason.zh: 第 4 章把延迟（ns）与带宽（GB/s）用利特尔法则连成一体：3,350 GB/s × 80 ns 的 HBM 总线必须保持 268 KB 在途数据才能跑满。
reason.en: Chapter 4 links latency (ns) and bandwidth (GB/s) via Little's Law: a 3,350 GB/s, 80 ns bus needs 268 KB simultaneously in flight to reach peak.

label.zh: 共享内存总线给多核扩展封顶
label.en: Shared memory bus caps multicore scaling

reason.zh: 第 5 章表明在登纳德缩放结束后，多核既受串行比例（阿姆达尔定律）限制，又会在 16 核处把 192 GB/s 共享 DDR 总线吃满而停滞。
reason.en: Chapter 5 shows that after Dennard scaling ended, multicore scaling hits both serial fractions (Amdahl) and shared DDR bus saturation at 16x.

label.zh: 用万级并发线程掩盖内存延迟
label.en: Hide latency with massive warp concurrency

reason.zh: 第 6 章直接应用第 4 章的利特尔法则：GPU 用大量并发线程切换掩盖访存等待，再用脉动阵列把权重留在片上复用。
reason.en: Chapter 6 applies chapter 4's Little's Law: GPUs hide latency across thousands of threads while systolic arrays reuse weights on chip.

label.zh: 从缓存分块重用到脉动阵列片上重用
label.en: From tiled cache reuse to systolic on-chip reuse

reason.zh: 第 6 章把第 3 章的矩阵数据重用推向硬件结构：脉动阵列与批量 M 共同决定线性层的算术强度。
reason.en: Chapter 6 extends chapter 3's matrix reuse into hardware: systolic arrays and batch size M govern a linear layer's arithmetic intensity.

label.zh: 把算术强度与硬件天花板画成屋顶线
label.en: Plot intensity against peak compute and bandwidth

reason.zh: 第 7 章把第 6 章的算术强度 I 与芯片峰值算力、带宽合为屋顶线模型 min(π, β×I)，给出屋脊拐点 I* = π/β。
reason.en: Chapter 7 combines chapter 6's arithmetic intensity I with peak compute and bandwidth into the Roofline envelope min(π, β×I) and ridge point I*.

label.zh: 单批解码落在大斜坡最左端
label.en: Single-batch decode sits far left on the slope

reason.zh: 第 8 章用第 7 章屋顶线拆解大模型解码：B=1 时算术强度约 1.05 FLOP/B，H100 算力利用率仅 0.36%，靠量化与批处理往右爬。
reason.en: Chapter 8 applies chapter 7's Roofline to LLM decode: at B=1, arithmetic intensity is ~1.05 FLOP/B (0.36% H100 util), so quantization and batching shift it right.

label.zh: 削减 KV 缓存字节直接换来长文吐字加速
label.en: Shrinking KV bytes directly speeds up decode

reason.zh: 第 8 章给出解码阶段的屋顶线瓶颈（带宽 ÷ 权重与 KV 字节），《混合注意力是怎么“记住”长文的》第 8 章据此把省下的 75% KV 缓存换算成生成速度提升。
reason.en: Chapter 8 establishes the bandwidth-bound decode roofline, which how-hybrid-attention-remembers #ch8 uses to turn 75% KV savings into higher tokens/s.

label.zh: 从延迟差距深入到能量账单
label.en: From latency gaps to the energy bill

reason.zh: 第 9 章用 Horowitz 45nm 能耗数据解释第 2 章层级差距的物理代价：片外 DRAM 搬运占一次乘加总能耗的 99.5%，HBM 通过硅中介层缩短连线。
reason.en: Chapter 9 explains the physical cost behind chapter 2: off-chip DRAM movement takes 99.5% of unreused MAC energy, motivating HBM's short interposer traces.

label.zh: 迈向 2048-bit HBM4 与共封装光学
label.en: Pushing to 2048-bit HBM4 and co-packaged optics

reason.zh: 第 10 章展示第 9 章封装与互联思路在 2026 年的延续：JEDEC JESD270-4 把位宽翻倍到 2,048-bit，光引擎走上芯片共封装。
reason.en: Chapter 10 traces chapter 9's packaging and interconnect trajectory into late 2026: 2,048-bit HBM4 (JESD270-4) and co-packaged optics.

label.zh: 把全篇收拢为四个排障问题
label.en: Distill the models into four diagnostic checks

reason.zh: 第 11 章把第 2–10 章的模型收拢成步长局部性、算术强度与屋脊拐点、在途并发、片外边界四项检查。
reason.en: Chapter 11 summarizes chapters 2–10 into four checks: stride locality, arithmetic intensity vs ridge point, in-flight concurrency, and off-chip boundaries.
